summary: NCR Voyix filed a routine Form 8-K furnishing third-quarter 2026 earnings, not a special situation. The item metadata header references Item 2.01, but the body reports Item 2.02 results of operations and Item 7.01 Regulation FD disclosure, with Exhibit 99.1 being the quarterly press release. Quarterly revenue was $539 million versus $677 million, reflecting the Hardware Business Transition; software and services revenue were flat at $500 million, recurring revenue $428 million, and net income from continuing operations $14 million. A management call was scheduled for 8:00 a.m. Eastern on November 5, 2026. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed; no risk-arb angle exists.
